## Scope

Kiteplanet is intentionally **open and account-free**: no login, no user profiles, no database.
Features that require authentication, stored user state, or a backend service are out of scope —
please open these as discussions in a fork rather than issues here.

New **spots** (`src/data/spots/`) and new **data providers** (behind `withResilience`) are very
welcome — see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md).
